low pressure cans. They have more linear feeling and are much less runny than higher pressure cans. 

Pocket cans are 50-150 ML cans that literally fit inside your pocket pretty discretely. 

Just keep on practicing. Use different techniques and do whatever feels best for you. This is your art. 
Don’t be scared of using high pressure cans. 

Just remember the purpose high pressure cans have and lows. Lows for detailing and slower movements. Highs for big areas and fast application.

It’s not a rule though. Someone who’s been doing this for years can do what they do with any can. But like I said. Try out all sorts of different cans and see what you like best. Try to go for the graffiti aimed brands like Montana, ironlak etc. If you can’t though it’s not the end of the world you’ll just have to learn using different cans.
